source.title: Maximum Energy Boost From Two Drinks

teaching.hint: What part of the previous schedule affects which drinks are available this hour?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: Switching has a one-hour opportunity cost, so a locally better drink need not improve the full schedule.
solution_outline.approach: Track the best totals associated with each drink side after every hour. Staying adds this hour’s drink value; moving to the other side uses this hour for cleansing and adds zero.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: Each side’s value is the best schedule prefix that ends ready for that side, including a possible cleanse hour. Both transitions read the preceding hour’s states.
solution_outline.correctness: Every valid schedule’s last hour either drinks on its current side or is the cleansing hour of a switch. The transitions cover both cases and choose the best prefix, so the larger final state is optimal.
solution_outline.complexity: `O(n)` time and `O(1)` auxiliary space; use a wide total.
solution_outline.pitfall: Switching cannot collect the destination drink’s energy in the same hour.

common_wrong_turns: Choosing the larger hourly value greedily
Giving energy during a cleanse hour
source_fidelity_notes: Removed examples; retained either starting drink and the lost hour when switching.
